svg.text: LLM RL POST-TRAINING ARCHITECTURE: PPO VS. GRPO, VERL HYBRIDENGINE & PARTIAL ROLLOUT
Critic-Free GRPO + FP8 Rollout + Partial Rollout Continuation Speeds Up RL Steps 6.69x
128x H200 Reasoning RL (32K Max Rollout): Tier 1 4-Model PPO (495s/step) vs. Tier 2 Sync veRL (198s) vs. Tier 4 (74s/step, -85.0% Cost)
⛔ Tier 1 & 2 Traps: `36Ψ` PPO & 32K Rollout Stragglers
1. Why 4-Model `PPO` Consumes `36Ψ` Static HBM (`2.5 TB` on 70B!):
• Trainable Actor (`16Ψ`) + Trainable Critic (`16Ψ`) + Frozen
Reference (`2Ψ`) + Reward Model (`2Ψ`) = `36 Bytes/param`!
2. Why Rollout Generation Takes 80% of RL Wall-Clock Time:
• Sampling `G=16` responses of up to `32K` thinking tokens per
prompt makes RL predominantly an inference-bound workload!
3. The Long-Tail `32K` Rollout Barrier Bubble (`38.5%–64.2%` Idle):
• 95% of prompts finish in `4K` tokens while 127 GPUs wait on 1 `32K`!
Tier 1 (4-Model PPO) & Tier 2 (Sync Barrier) Impact:
• Tier 1 Step Duration: 495s (95s disk sync + 64.2% rollout bubble)
• Tier 2 Sync Colocated veRL: 198s/step (38.5% long-tail bubble)
• Cost per 1,000 RL Steps: $62,000 (Tier 1) / $24,800 (Tier 2)
🏆 Tier 4: Critic-Free GRPO + FP8 Rollout + Partial Cont.
1. Critic-Free `GRPO` + Rule Verifier (`36Ψ -> 18Ψ` Memory Cut):
• Replaces Critic & Reward models with group-normalized advantage
`A_i = (r_i - mean(r)) / std(r)` + deterministic code/math sandbox!
2. `1.6s` In-Memory Zero-Copy Weight Resharding (`FSDP -> FP8 vLLM`):
• Reshards `FSDP/3D` BF16 weights into `TP=4/8 FP8` SGLang/vLLM
engines in HBM/NVLink in `1.6s` (`2x` faster FP8 rollout!)
3. Partial Rollout Continuation (`Slime / Async K=1`):
• Pauses unfinished `32K` chains at step cutoff & resumes their KV next step!
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks (128x H200):
• RL Step Duration: 74.0s (6.69x faster than Tier 1!)
• Weight Reshard Time: 1.6s | Long-Tail Bubble: Only 5.8%
• Cost per 1,000 RL Steps: $9,300 (-85.0% savings vs. Tier 1)
